# CopyPixelFast <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Buffers and Pixels](BlitzBasic-Buffers-and-Pixels)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CopyPixelFast:Void src_x:Int32, src_y:Int32, src_buffer:Int32, dest_x:Int32, dest_y:Int32, dest_buffer:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `src_x` | In | Int32 | required | Horizontal position of the pixel to copy. |
| `src_y` | In | Int32 | required | Vertical position of the pixel to copy. |
| `src_buffer` | In | Int32 | required | The locked buffer to copy from. |
| `dest_x` | In | Int32 | required | Horizontal position to copy to. |
| `dest_y` | In | Int32 | required | Vertical position to copy to. |
| `dest_buffer` | In | Int32 | `0` | The locked buffer to copy to. Defaults to the current buffer. |

## Description

The quick form of [CopyPixel](CopyPixel). Both buffers must be locked with [LockBuffer](LockBuffer) first, and the position is not checked against the edges of the original.

## Differences

* A buffer that is not locked is ignored by a build without `-d`, and stops a debug build (`-d`) with an error message. Positions outside of a buffer are ignored instead of writing into other memory like the original could.
* Pixels are copied with all the bits that the buffers have: a buffer made by [Graphics3D](Graphics3D) with the depth 64 does not lose anything on the way. See [Color depth](Graphics#color-depth).
